description: This file defines structures, enums, and function prototypes for managing branches in a version control system, including creating, validating, and tracking branches.

methods.name: dwim_and_setup_tracking
methods.description: Sets up tracking configuration for a branch based on the specified tracking mode.

methods.name: create_branch
methods.description: Creates a new branch in a repository with various options.

methods.name: create_branches_recursively
methods.description: Creates a new branch and its submodules recursively, with tracking information.

methods.name: branch_checked_out
methods.description: Returns the path to the worktree where a branch is checked out.

methods.name: validate_branchname
methods.description: Validates a branch name and fills the ref; returns existence status.

methods.name: validate_new_branchname
methods.description: Validates if a new branch name can be created; fills ref and returns existence status.

methods.name: remove_merge_branch_state
methods.description: Removes merge state information from the current branch.

methods.name: remove_branch_state
methods.description: Removes working state information from the current branch.

methods.name: install_branch_config
methods.description: Configures local branch as downstream of a remote branch.

methods.name: read_branch_desc
methods.description: Reads the description of a branch.

methods.name: die_if_checked_out
methods.description: Checks if a branch is checked out and terminates if so.
